Liam: heads-up — CI job 'smoke-inference' failed to allocate requested GPUs for perf run. error snippet: `ALLOC_ERR: no-available-slots (region=us-west2, sku=A100)` https://redwood.app/builds/ci-4521
Zoe: hmm region saturated this morning. what's current pool headroom?
infra-bot: Pool snapshot: us-west2-demo: capacity=24, used=24, queued=3. Fallback pools: us-west1 (8 free), eu-west1 (6 free).
Liam: we need 4 A100s for the smoke run (30m). prefer not to cross-region since tests bind to us-west2. can vendor offer preemptible slots?
Nadia: vendor msg earlier said maintenance in us-west2 tonight but there might be transient free slots now. @vendor-ops can you check soft-allocs or preauth?
vendor-ops: sending a quick ask. if you can accept preemptible, we can push 4xA100 preemptible now for up to 1h with 10% eviction risk. need a `--preemptible true` flag on request.
Zoe: OK for smoke. Liam, can CI switch the alloc command? sample: `/alloc request --pool ci-smoke --gpu a100 --count 4 --duration 1h --preemptible true --note "smoke-run preemptible"`
Liam: updating CI yaml now. also noticed tenant quota for infra-ci is at 95% of soft limit. who owns quota bump?
Nadia: quota is owned by platform capacity team, but we can temporary-bypass with preauth if finance ok. vendor-ops can preauth 1h while we open a ticket to increase soft cap.
infra-bot: Created ticket CAP-9102 (temp preauth) and CI change PR #8812.
vendor-ops: preauth granted for 1h (ticket VEND-4491). Allocating 4xA100 -> provisioning ETA ~7m. will update when ephemeral hosts are live.
Liam: thanks. Zoe — after run please run `rctl lease list --owner ci-smoke` to make sure leases released cleanly.
Zoe: will do. also pinging @platform to follow up on quota bump request CAP-9103 (increase soft limit +10 for us-west2).
Nadia: quick note — if preemptible wins, add retry logic to CI to requeue on eviction instead of failing entire job. small PR incoming.
Liam: agreed. I'll hold CI until alloc shows `provisioning`. will post final status here. :thumbsup:
